description: Convert a Korean Hancom document (HWP 5.x or HWPX) at a URL to Markdown with tables preserved, including merged cells as HTML, text boxes, footnotes and distributable (배포용) documents. Typical sources: Korean government press releases, notices and law annexes. Encrypted or DRM files are reported, not converted. Price: $0.01 USDC per call, paid with x402 on Base.
name: kr_hwp_to_markdown
